properties.summary: IODA's darknet signal, which counts unsolicited traffic reaching the Merit Network Telescope, fell in 12 countries whose dips were open at the same time (Sweden -98.8%, Netherlands -93.5%, Azerbaijan -92.7%, Russia -90.5%, Côte d'Ivoire -89.8%, Singapore -89.2%, Georgia -86.5%, United Arab Emirates -84.6%, Iraq -84.6%, Turkey -83.9%, Belarus -83.5%, Germany -64.2%; the first from 04:11 UTC 22 Nov 2026). BGP and active probing held in each, so no country's connectivity is measured as down. One signal falling in many countries at once reads as a change at the telescope's side (BO-H-1C, BO-IND-4), so Blackout lists it once rather than as 12 single-signal dips. Each country's reading stays on the page's Outages tab.
